messages:
Priya Rao: Quick sync — need smoke tests + CI hooks for partner IaC templates (AWS/GCP/OCI). Goal: run on PRs and as a marketplace validation step. Can partners run them locally? Need minimal coverage: terraform init/plan, tflint/checkov, basic deploy-to-emulator (localstack) smoke if possible. Target: V1 by EOW.

Joel Kim: SGTM. Do we have a standard GH Actions job or should we add a reusable workflow? Prefer reusable so partners can call it from their repos.

Sam Patel: I can draft a reusable workflow. What inputs should it take? vendor, cloud, module_path, module_version, run_localstack boolean?

Dmitri Ivanov: Add version pinning policy and artifact uploads (plan + lint + checkov reports). Fail PR on high severity. Medium -> annotate for now.

Joel Kim: For local smoke: localstack for AWS, emulator where feasible for GCP. But start minimal: terraform init, validate, plan-out -> json.

Priya Rao: Minimal job example (please reuse):
```yaml
name: IaC smoke
on: [pull_request]
jobs:
  smoke:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - name: Setup Terraform
        uses: hashicorp/setup-terraform@v1
      - name: terraform init
        run: terraform init -input=false
      - name: terraform validate
        run: terraform validate
      - name: tflint
        run: tflint --no-color || true
```

Sam Patel: I'll make a reusable workflow at .github/workflows/partner-iac-smoke.yml and add inputs for cloud and module_path. Also adding artifact upload step.

Sam Patel: Also adding a small helper script for plan-only so no creds are required for V1:
```bash
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
terraform init -input=false
terraform plan -var='region=us-west-2' -out=plan.tfplan
terraform show -json plan.tfplan > plan.json
```

Joel Kim: Add checkov scan step too: checkov -d . -o json > checkov.json and then upload as artifact.

ci-bot: [ci-bot] test run triggered by @Sam Patel on branch feature/partner-iac

ci-bot: Test results: terraform init/validate passed; tflint warnings: 2; checkov findings: high:0, medium:1 -> medium annotated

Priya Rao: Good. V1 policy: fail on high findings, annotate medium. Sam, open PR with workflow + README snippet linking to internal doc https://docs.redwood.com/partnerships/iac-smoke-tests

Sam Patel: On it. I'll include a sample module in examples/ that uses minimal resources and default vars for quick plan. Also adding pre-commit hooks: terraform fmt, terraform validate.

Joel Kim: For modules include examples/simple/main.tf with small S3 bucket (for AWS) and variable defaults so it plans without secrets. Keep examples short and documented.

Dmitri Ivanov: Also add a compatibility matrix docs/compatibility.md listing supported clouds, provider version constraints, and notes on arm64 vs x86 for CI runners.

Priya Rao: EOW deliverables: reusable GH workflow, sample module with examples/, docs/compatibility.md, CI artifact uploads. Thanks team :rocket:
